_comment: bd-2555 — build contract for the Railway `portal` service.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The portal SPA used to be built on a developer's
laptop and hand-copied into dashboard/portal-frontend/dist, which was then
COMMITTED to git (via .gitignore negations) and served verbatim by
express.static. Railway built nothing: the service had rootDirectory
=/dashboard, so portal/ source was not even in the build context.
When someone forgot the copy, the PR merged, CI went green, and production
kept serving the old bundle. On 2026-08-12 prod and staging both served a
bundle 122KB behind the source, leaving the i18n Phase 5.x work half-live:
the server route shipped, the frontend calling it did not. Commit 5075607
('rebuild SPA dist — #87 was merged but never shipped') shows it had
already happened at least once before.
THE SETTINGS THIS FILE DOCUMENTS. Railway service config is not stored in
the repo, so it is recorded here to keep it reviewable and diffable:
rootDirectory: "/"         (repo root — portal/ must be in the context.
The bot and worker services store this as
null; the API does NOT clear the field when
sent null, so "/" is the value that actually
takes. Verified by reading it back — sending
null silently left it at /dashboard.)
buildCommand:  npm run build:portal
startCommand:  node dashboard/entrypoint.js
buildCommand runs the SAME npm script a developer runs, so a deploy is
reproducible locally. Do not inline the build steps into the Railway UI —
a command that exists only in a text box cannot be code-reviewed.
This is a documentation artifact: railpack reads railpack.json (shared by
every service in this repo), not this file. The apt packages below are
NOT duplicated here for that reason.
